ModMetaData.name: Pillage & Plunder
ModMetaData.author: lordfelix
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]Pillage & Plunder[/h1] Enemy settlements no longer vanish after a single battle. Raid them, extort what you need, and leave them alive to rebuild — turning one-time conquests into a living, breathing world of persistent rivals worth raiding again and again.
[h1]Features[/h1]
[b]⚔ Raid instead of destroy[/b] [list] [*] A new [b]"Plunder Settlement"[/b] option sits right alongside vanilla "Attack" — in both the world-map right-click menu and the caravan command bar. [*] Choose annihilation OR exploitation: plundered settlements survive on the map instead of being wiped out. [*] Works on [b]hostile, neutral, and allied[/b] settlements (friendly targets ask for confirmation first). [/list]
[b]💰 Extort what you need[/b] [list] [*] Win the battle, then pick [b]one[/b] reward from a clean loot screen: [*] [b]Silver[/b] — cold, hard cash. [*] [b]Food[/b] — packaged survival meals. [*] [b]Materials[/b] — steel and components. [*] [b]Prisoners[/b] — captives dropped unconscious, ready to haul home. [*] Loot is delivered [b]right at your pawns' feet[/b] — no drop pods, no fuss. Just grab it and reform your caravan. [/list]
[b]📈 Wealth-based loot[/b] [list] [*] Rich settlements pay out big; poor ones far less. Loot scales with the target's actual wealth. [/list]
[b]🔥 Settlements remember[/b] [list] [*] Raided bases enter a [b]Devastated[/b] recovery state, marked with a custom burning-ruin icon on the world map. [*] While recovering: [b]no trading[/b], and defenders are gutted to a skeleton crew if you strike again. [*] Recovery takes several in-game days — and longer each time you hit the same target. [/list]
[b]⏳ Diminishing returns — no free lunch[/b] [list] [*] Hammer the same settlement repeatedly and the loot dries up fast. [*] Survivors [b]fortify[/b]: once recovered, previously-raided bases field tougher defenses. [/list]
[b]🗡 Diplomatic fallout[/b] [list] [*] Allies of your victim [b]condemn[/b] the raid (goodwill hit). [*] Their enemies [b]applaud[/b] you (goodwill gain). [*] Beware — raided factions may launch a [b]revenge raid[/b] on your colony days later. [/list]
[b]⚙ Configurable[/b] [list] [*] A [b]Loot Reward Multiplier[/b] slider in Mod Settings lets you tune payouts from 0.1x to 5x to fit your difficulty. [/list]
[h1]Compatibility & Performance[/h1] [list] [*] [b]Safe to add[/b] to existing saves. [*] No new items or defs — purely enhances vanilla settlement raiding, so it plays nice with most mods. [*] Fault-isolated patches and zero ticking overhead — no performance cost when you're not raiding. [/list]
